parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing an intended future action or sequence of actions.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning contains future-directed language identifying an action or sequence of actions the agent intends to perform.
The intended action is presented as the agent's plan rather than as a mere conditional possibility.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports or summarizes actions already performed.
The reasoning only states a fact or conclusion without expressing an intended future action.

candidate_predicates.name: PROPOSES_VERIFICATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly identifies a need or intention to check, validate, test, or independently corroborate a claim, artifact, or result.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing verification or validation intent.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning contains an explicit call or intention to verify, validate, test, cross-check, or confirm something.
The claim, artifact, or result to be verified is identifiable from the reasoning.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only performs or reports an action without expressing verification intent.
The reasoning only states a conclusion without proposing a check of it.

candidate_predicates.name: IDENTIFIES_DATA_AMBIGUITY
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning identifies that a token, value, or record in the data can be interpreted in more than one semantic role, creating a risk of misclassification.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying an ambiguity or misclassification risk in the data.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning points to a specific token or value that may appear in more than one role or be confused with another role.
The reasoning distinguishes the intended structured interpretation from an alternative that could cause incorrect counting or parsing.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely describes a data format without identifying an ambiguity or misclassification risk.
The reasoning selects a parsing rule without noting any competing interpretation.

candidate_predicates.name: RESOLVES_CONFLICTING_CONSTRAINTS
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning identifies a conflict between two constraints or information sources and explicitly selects which one governs the task.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying conflicting constraints and selecting the governing one.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning mentions at least two conflicting constraints, values, or information sources.
The reasoning states which constraint or source is authoritative or will be used.
exclusion_conditions: Only one constraint or information source is mentioned.
A conflict is implied but the reasoning does not select a governing constraint or source.

candidate_predicates.name: DERIVES_STRUCTURE_MODEL_FROM_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning infers a general format, schema, or structural model from the content of an observation, such that the model can be applied to other records or data items.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating a generalized format, schema, or structural model.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation containing example records, counts, or distributional evidence from which the structure is derived.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains example records, counts, or distributional evidence about the data.
The reasoning states a generalized pattern, format, or structural rule derived from that observation.
The derived model is applicable beyond the specific examples present in the observation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only repeats a concrete value from the observation.
The reasoning draws a task-level conclusion that does not generalize the data's structure.
The observation is unrelated to the stated structure.

candidate_predicates.name: GROUNDS_CONCLUSION_IN_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning states a conclusion that is supported by identifiable information in the observation.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating a conclusion supported by the observation.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying evidence for the stated conclusion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a conclusion or judgment.
The observation contains specific content that supports that conclusion.
The evidential connection is identifiable rather than merely topical.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the observation without drawing a conclusion.
The observation is unrelated to the conclusion or provides no identifiable support.
The reasoning states a plan rather than a conclusion supported by the observation.

candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_ASSUMPTION_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted action tests a specific assumption or uncertainty identified in the reasoning, and the resulting observation provides interpretable evidence about that assumption.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action performing the targeted test.

parameters.name: assumption_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the assumption or uncertainty being tested.

parameters.name: probe_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result relevant to the assumption.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific assumption, doubt, or uncertainty.
The action is directed at testing that assumption or resolving that uncertainty.
The observation reports a result that can be interpreted as evidence for or against the assumption.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the stated assumption.
The observation does not address the assumption being tested.
No identifiable assumption or uncertainty motivates the test.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_ARTIFACT_CONFORMANCE
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning indicates that an artifact's format or content must be checked, an action inspects the artifact, and the observation reports properties consistent with the required or expected form.

parameters.name: verification_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning expressing an intention to verify an artifact against expected format or content.

parameters.name: inspection_action
parameters.description: The action reading or inspecting the artifact.

parameters.name: inspection_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the inspected artifact's properties.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning expresses an intention to verify or check an artifact against a required or expected format or content.
The action reads or inspects the artifact.
The observation reports artifact properties that satisfy the stated or expected format or content requirement.
exclusion_conditions: The inspection reveals a violation of the expected format or content.
The reasoning does not state or imply any conformance requirement for the artifact.
The observation is unrelated to the artifact inspected.

candidate_predicates.name: OBSERVATION_CONTRADICTS_EXPECTATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning states an expected property or desired condition, and the observation contains evidence that the condition is violated.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating an expected property or desired condition.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation containing evidence that contradicts the stated expectation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning expresses a specific expected property, desired condition, or absence of a defect.
The observation contains content showing that the expected property or desired condition does not hold.
exclusion_conditions: The observation confirms the expected property or desired condition.
The difference between the observation and the expectation is not identifiable or is irrelevant to the stated expectation.
The reasoning does not state any expectation or desired condition.

candidate_predicates.name: CORROBORATES_WITH_INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTATION
candidate_predicates.definition: An earlier result is corroborated when a materially independent recomputation or alternative method produces matching values and the reasoning recognizes the agreement.

parameters.name: corroboration_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the independent result as matching or corroborating the original result.

parameters.name: independent_action
parameters.description: The action performing a materially independent recomputation or alternative check.

parameters.name: independent_observation
parameters.description: The observation produced by the independent recomputation.

parameters.name: original_observation
parameters.description: The earlier observation containing the original result being corroborated.

assertion_conditions: The independent action performs a recomputation or check using a procedure that is materially different from the one that produced the original observation.
The independent observation reports values that match the original observation.
The corroboration reasoning identifies the independent result as matching, confirming, or corroborating the original result.
exclusion_conditions: The same procedure is repeated without material independence.
The independent observation reports values that differ from the original observation.
No reasoning node identifies the comparison or agreement between the results.

candidate_predicates.name: CLEANS_UP_INTERMEDIATE_ARTIFACT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning expresses an intention to remove a temporary or auxiliary artifact so that only permitted deliverables remain; the action removes it, and the observation confirms that the artifact is gone and the deliverable remains.

parameters.name: cleanup_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning expressing intent to remove an auxiliary or temporary artifact.

parameters.name: cleanup_action
parameters.description: The action deleting the auxiliary or temporary artifact.

parameters.name: post_cleanup_observation
parameters.description: The observation confirming the artifact's absence and the remaining deliverable.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that an auxiliary or temporary artifact should be removed to comply with output or scope constraints.
The action deletes that artifact.
The observation shows that the removed artifact is absent and the intended deliverable remains.
exclusion_conditions: The action removes a required deliverable.
The observation does not confirm the artifact's absence or the deliverable's presence.
No reasoning expresses cleanup intent.

candidate_predicates.name: IMPLEMENTS_DISAMBIGUATION_CONSTRAINT
candidate_predicates.definition: The action implements a matching or extraction rule that is restricted to a structured field identified in the reasoning, preventing occurrences of the same token in free text from being counted as that field.

parameters.name: constraint_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying a structured field and the risk of confusion with free-text occurrences.

parameters.name: constraint_action
parameters.description: The action applying a field-specific or anchored matching rule.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a structured field and a risk that the same token may appear elsewhere in free text.
The action's matching or extraction logic is restricted to the structured field or to a position anchored to that field.
The restriction distinguishes the intended field from free-text occurrences of the token.
exclusion_conditions: The action uses unrestricted text matching for the token.
The reasoning does not identify a structured field or a risk of confusion with free text.
The action's matching rule is unrelated to the structured field identified in the reasoning.

candidate_predicates.name: EXECUTES_PLANNED_ACTION
candidate_predicates.definition: The action performs the specific future action that the reasoning explicitly stated it would perform.

parameters.name: planned_action
parameters.description: The action that executes the stated intention.

parameters.name: plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning explicitly stating the intended future action.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly states an intended future action, including an identifiable operation or target.
The action performs that operation on that target or an equivalent target.
exclusion_conditions: The action does not correspond to the stated intention.
The reasoning only describes a general goal without an identifiable intended action.
The action was performed before the plan was stated.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_RESULT_SET_CONSISTENCY
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning confirms that a set of reported results satisfies known logical relationships such as containment, ordering, or monotonicity among the result categories.

parameters.name: consistency_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning checking expected logical relationships among result values.

parameters.name: result_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the result values being checked.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states one or more expected relationships among result values or categories.
The reasoning checks the observed result values against those relationships and concludes that they are consistent.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only restates the result values without checking relationships among them.
The reasoning reports a violation of the expected relationships rather than confirming consistency.
The observation does not contain the result values being checked.
